notes.title: Mobile Version of Dr. Psycho: Hospital Escape 2 is out!
notes.notes:
Dr. Psycho: Hospital Escape 2 is now available in App Store and you can play it on your iPhone or iPad!
Check it out here: [url=https://apps.apple.com/us/app/dr-psycho-2-scary-escape-game/id6461824005]App Store[/url]
